catalogue_snapshot.freeze_rule: Official catalogue positions, names, families, and duplicate entries are frozen row-for-row; lifecycle and QuickPLS states are independently governed.

comparison_policy.rule: Compare documented user outcomes within an explicitly bounded QuickPLS scope; do not claim copied internals, numerical identity, full parity, or SmartPLS project compatibility.
comparison_policy.competitive_scope: All non-legacy catalogue entries are in the QuickPLS 3.0 competitor scope. Legacy Blindfolding and GoF are intentionally deferred and must remain disclosed.
comparison_policy.status_source_of_truth: Capability Registry V2 is the current option-cell authority. Each method-manifest-linked option cell is fail-closed against the live state re-derived from its exact manifest; capability-cell contracts are separately validated by their exact qualification link. The historical parity ledger and generated legacy catalogue are non-authoritative records and projections. Editable row status, source-file references, and historical artifacts cannot promote a claim.

state_contract.active_definition: Rows whose official_lifecycle is active; legacy Blindfolding and GoF remain explicit catalogue rows but are not active.
state_contract.separation_rule: Every option_cells entry independently governs coverage, evidence, and product surface. Evidence never upgrades coverage. Row-level coverage_state, evidence_state, and surface are conservative compatibility projections derived from their option cells and are never authoritative.

customer_visibility_policy.availability_rule: A selected option cell is Supported only when it is explicitly assigned to Standard, has release-qualified evidence, and has full coverage or a nonempty documented partial scope; executable Labs cells remain opt-in. Row projections never make a cell available.

surface_contract.standard_rule: Each selected option cell independently requires surface=standard, evidence_state=release_qualified, and either full coverage or partial coverage with a nonempty documented QuickPLS scope.
surface_contract.fail_closed_rule: A Standard-labelled option cell that fails either release or scope requirements is unavailable; an eligible Labs cell requires explicit opt-in. Row projections never grant visibility.

product_area_contract.completeness_rule: Every row declares all user-facing product surfaces that parity work must assess; a listed surface is not itself a completeness claim.

qualification_link_contract.identity_rule: The four-field object is the complete deterministic identity; extra fields are forbidden.

legacy_catalogue_contract.projection_rule: The frozen header plus each capability legacy_row generates the legacy schema-v1 catalogue deterministically, with legacy status derived from the conservative option-cell row projection. Row-level coverage_state, evidence_state, and surface are stored only as checked compatibility projections. This registry does not overwrite that file.
